property_summary: For any inputs, C.transfer always returns true only if every low-level call to the provided caddress succeeded; the mutant that drops the require can return true even when a callee call fails, so there exists inputs (a failing callee and non-empty _tos) where the mutant returns true but the reference either reverts or would not return true.
change_summary: Remove the require(_s) after the external call so failing calls do not revert and transfer can return true despite call failures.
